description.fun: Sunkern knows it's weak, so it moves as little as it can and drinks only dew, saving every scrap of nutrition for the day it evolves. Sometimes Sunkern fall from the sky early in the morning, and nobody knows why. A year after a cold summer, their numbers boom.
description.guide: A small, seed-like Grass-type Pokémon that is very weak and moves as little as possible to save its nutrients for evolution. It drinks only dew. A Sun Stone evolves it into Sunflora.
description.tagline: A seed saving everything for the day it evolves

description.fun: Sunflora turns its face to follow the sun all day, bustling about while it's up and stopping dead the moment it sets, petals closed. The warmer the weather, the brighter its petals. Besides all that sunshine, it needs plenty of water.
description.guide: A sunflower Pokémon of the Grass type, evolved from Sunkern with a Sun Stone. It turns sunlight into nutrition and always faces the sun, moving busily by day and stopping at sunset. Its petals grow more vivid in warm weather.
description.tagline: Always facing the sun, and stock-still once it sets
